name: manual_9f9dec
claim: Before switching git branches directly in a shared checkout, always run git status first -- if it shows uncommitted changes and this repo has other concurrent agent sessions active, those changes may belong to a live in-progress session, not stray state to discard. Do NOT git stash/checkout/reset past them. Per this repo's own CLAUDE.md § 8 ('create a worktree when the task requires parallel file writes by multiple agents'), spin up a worktree for your own task instead and leave the shared checkout untouched -- then fetch the actual target branch into that worktree if the task is against a specific existing PR/branch, not main.

decisions.notes: Hit live during PR #208 CodeRabbit-fix work (2026-07-12): git status on phase-2-stm-concurrency-dedup showed uncommitted edits to exactly the files a concurrent Codex session was working on (agent_coordination.py, heartbeat_monitor.py, tests). Used a worktree instead of touching the shared checkout; the other session committed its own work cleanly a short time later with zero collision.
